Class DEditSchema

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--model.DEditSchema
public final class DEditSchema
extends java.lang.Object

Class which wraps a Schema and verifier and all the various things DEditor uses it for.

DEditSchema

public DEditSchema(model.DEditor deditor,
                   boolean relaxed)
Constructor for DEditSchema which keeps track of what DEditor created it, and register whether or not it should operate under "relaxed" mode which may allow some illegal choices.

Parameters:
deditor - the DEditor "owner" of this DEditSchema
relaxed - true if the Schema should operate under "relaxed" mode
Method Detail

getTopName

public java.lang.String getTopName()
Gets the String name associated with the top level element in an XML following this DEditSchema's XML Schema. It Assumes top level is first required tag inside of tag, or last tag if all are optional

Returns:
the String name for the top level element in an XML given this DEditSchema's associated XML Schema

isReady

public boolean isReady()
Returns whether or not this DEditSchema is ready to do any validating or generating work.

Returns:
true if this DEditSchema can validate and generate, should be true after successful calls to DEditSchema.loadSchema().

loadSchema

public boolean loadSchema(java.lang.String schemaFilename)
                   throws DEditSchemaException
Loads a schema and returns true for success although it shouldn't need to; a DEditSchemaException should be thrown on any error

Parameters:
schemaFilename - the filename of the XML Schema file to be used by this DEditSchema.
Returns:
true if this call was a success

getRequiredSubElementNames

public java.lang.String[] getRequiredSubElementNames(org.w3c.dom.Node node,
                                                     com.sun.msv.grammar.ElementExp exp)
Returns, as an array of Strings, all required names for elements which are children of the element represented by the node passed in, which presumably lines up with the ElementExp passed in. This function is a helper that prevents retraversal of the tree to get the relevant expression (in this case ElementExp exp) if you are recursively running this function.

Parameters:
node - the node to find required sub-element names for
exp - the ElementExp corresponding to node, should == getRelevantExpression(node)
Returns:
an array of required sub-element names, or null if none are found

getAttributes

public model.DEditAttributeInfo[] getAttributes(org.w3c.dom.Node node)
Gets, as an array, all attributes corresponding to node in the form of DEditAttributeInfo's. From this they can be compared to what is in Node to be turned into the current node status plus information about what else is allowable (though that step is not done here).

Parameters:
node - the Node to get attributes for
Returns:
an array of DEditAttributeInfo's containing information about various attributes for Node node

generateRequiredChildren

public void generateRequiredChildren(model.DEditNode parent,
                                     javax.swing.tree.DefaultTreeModel model)
DEditor.java uses this to generate a default JTree and DOM tree given this DEditSchema. After calling this function the DOM tree should be valid under the input DEditNode given the schema.

Parameters:
parent - the DEditNode to generate children for.
model - the DefaultTreeModel used to modify the JTree that DEditNode parent is part of

printoutSchema

public void printoutSchema()
Prints out a tree representation of the XML Schema for this DEditSchema to standard out. Warning: this can be quite long. This function is called by DEditSchema.main() which functions as a way to inspect a Schema you have created.

main

public static void main(java.lang.String[] args)

Parameters:
args - arguments -- the first should be the schema to use
